entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "No. Titus and his men have been allowed to roam the Palace with impunity since the Golden Guard was reinstated. They could have entered the archives and destroyed it at any time."

entries.dialogueText: "Your father could have taken it himself. His medicine stores were cleared out long before this investigation began."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "There's still a small possibility that either Hugo or the Grand Wiseman slipped the poison to him."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Alternately, the Grand Vizier coul..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alternately, the Grand Vizier could have administered it to him. The two of them were alone in your father's room for several minutes."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But the discovery of the vial in T..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the discovery of the vial in Titus' possession, combined with the motive I've just unearthed, strongly points towards the Captain as our primary suspect."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You'll get them. I sent Captain Go..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll get them. I sent Captain Gordion a summons. He should be arriving any minute."

entries.dialogueText: "We'll find out shortly. I sent Captain Gordion a summons. He should be arriving any minute."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Captain Gordion has not been proven guilty yet. Unhand him at once."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards apologized and let go of..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards apologized and let go of Titus' arms. My guardsman produced an envelope.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His gaze shifted between the two of..."
entries.dialogueText: His gaze shifted between the two of us.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""She's viewed Wruhec's Guardians as..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's viewed Wruhec's Guardians as a threat ever since you and the Grand Wiseman established them."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""She's viewed the Golden Guard as a..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's viewed the Golden Guard as a threat ever since we were reinstated."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Need I remind you that I am the ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Need I remind you that I am the man standing between you and a full takeover of the throne by House Azaro?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Captain Gordion, how did that vial..."
entries.dialogueText: "Captain Gordion, how did that vial Duchess Azaro found come into your possession?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus, is it true that you went af..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus, is it true that you went after the security councilor position after General Azaro fell ill?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why did you leave your post the ni..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why did you leave your post the night King Valero died, Captain Gordion?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll bite. If Lucita was responsib..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll bite. If Lucita was responsible for poisoning my father, why and how would she have done it?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What? You can't honestly think tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? You can't honestly think that--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus cut her off."
entries.dialogueText: Titus cut her off.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus looked down, ashamed."
entries.dialogueText: Titus looked down, ashamed.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My old boxing injury flared up. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "My old boxing injury flared up. The pain became too much to bear, and I went to an unused guest room to recuperate."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Back in my boxing days, I sustaine..."
entries.dialogueText: "Back in my boxing days, I sustained a kidney injury that never fully healed."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It still flares up occasionally --..."
entries.dialogueText: "It still flares up occasionally -- like during my fight in Derdia. And unfortunately, on the night His Majesty died."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It still flares up occasionally. U..."
entries.dialogueText: "It still flares up occasionally. Unfortunately, it did so on the night His Majesty died."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The pain became too much to bear,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The pain became too much to bear, and I crept off to an unused guest room to recuperate."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The drug is mine, Your Majesty. I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "The drug is mine, Your Majesty. I'll admit that."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Back in my boxing days, I sustaine..."
entries.dialogueText: "Back in my boxing days, I sustained a kidney injury that never fully healed."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I take wolfsbane to manage the pai..."
entries.dialogueText: "I take wolfsbane to manage the pain."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I take it to manage the pain from..."
entries.dialogueText: "I take it to manage the pain from that old boxing injury I told you about."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Respectfully, Your Majesty, all yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Respectfully, Your Majesty, all you have is Duchess Azaro's word that this vial was found in my quarters."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""She herself could have manufacture..."
entries.dialogueText: "She herself could have manufactured it after reading the toxicology report."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Or used it the night Valero died,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or used it the night Valero died, and waited until just this moment to pin the crime on me."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Interesting, Captain.""
entries.dialogueText: "Interesting, Captain."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She folded her arms."
entries.dialogueText: She folded her arms.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You knew the Grand Wiseman was dru..."
entries.dialogueText: "You knew the Grand Wiseman was drugging Valero, and you happened to have a medicine in your possession that would augment that drug's effects."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He must have gone after Valero as..."
entries.dialogueText: "He must have gone after Valero as an act of revenge. Or in the hope that the King's successor would grant him a second chance at a council seat..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked pointedly at me."
entries.dialogueText: She looked pointedly at me.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I-- I did, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I-- I did, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I was too embarrassed to have ment..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was too embarrassed to have mentioned it to you. I was completely unqualified at the time."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Of course, I would not say the sam..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, I would not say the same now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita glowered at him."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita glowered at him.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Or you used it on the king yoursel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or you used it on the king yourself, knowing it would implicate me."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If you'll excuse me, I have no bus..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you'll excuse me, I have no business in the Palace these days. My duties in Montaklar are calling."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If that will be all, I'll see you..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that will be all, I'll see you soon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Captain. How are Wruhec's Guardian..."
entries.dialogueText: "Captain. How are Wruhec's Guardians handling their new duties?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Very well, sir. In fact... there's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well, sir. In fact... there's been a breakthrough in the investigation into your father's death."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""After the Grand Wiseman's exonerat..."
entries.dialogueText: "After the Grand Wiseman's exoneration, you tasked the Golden Guard with investigating a potential connection involving Duchess Azaro."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""After the Grand Wiseman's exonerat..."
entries.dialogueText: "After the Grand Wiseman's exoneration, you tasked the Golden Guard with investigating a potential connection involving Hugo Toras."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""However, our investigation was not..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, our investigation was not entirely fruitless. We have new findings to report."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""With advancements in technology, l..."
entries.dialogueText: "With advancements in technology, laboratories at Romus Toras University were able to conduct a more in-depth toxicology test using that very sample."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""They found traces of mandragora. A..."
entries.dialogueText: "They found traces of mandragora. A highly potent hallucinogen, known to cause death in large enough doses."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The tests confirmed the presence o..."
entries.dialogueText: "The tests confirmed the presence of mandragora in the king's system. But we also asked the technicians to test for less lethal toxins."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""They found traces of a plant calle..."
entries.dialogueText: "They found traces of a plant called wolfsbane."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wolfsbane? Are we back in fantasy..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wolfsbane? Are we back in fantasy world?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That doesn't sound good.""
entries.dialogueText: "That doesn't sound good."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What? How many drugs was my father..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? How many drugs was my father on?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Wolfsbane is used medicinally as a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wolfsbane is used medicinally as a painkiller. But it can also cause cardiac arrest in large enough doses."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""This is a real plant, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is a real plant, Your Majesty. Just like mandragora."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The amount found in your father's..."
entries.dialogueText: "The amount found in your father's bloodstream wasn't enough to kill him. But in combination with mandragora..."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We went back through the belonging..."
entries.dialogueText: "We went back through the belongings we confiscated after Duchess Azaro's arrest and found this in a shadow box containing her medals and insignia. The liquid inside is an exact match to the chemical the tests found."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He raised the vial he was holding...."
entries.dialogueText: He raised the vial he was holding. Looking closer, I saw a perfume label on it.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We conducted a covert search of Du..."
entries.dialogueText: "We conducted a covert search of Duchess Azaro's residence and found this in a shadow box containing her medals and insignia. The liquid inside is an exact match to the chemical the tests found."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""There's more. We found a possible..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's more. We found a possible motive."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pulled out a plastic bag contain..."
entries.dialogueText: He pulled out a plastic bag containing a document.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""This is the royal order naming Luc..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is the royal order naming Lucita Azaro interim security councilor in the wake of her father's illness. Signed the very day of King Valero's death."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pointed at a paragraph towards t..."
entries.dialogueText: He pointed at a paragraph towards the end of the document.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""After thoroughly scanning the docu..."
entries.dialogueText: "After thoroughly scanning the document, we found a palimpsest. A spot where older text had been scratched off and replaced."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As it turns out, Duchess Azaro was..."
entries.dialogueText: "As it turns out, Duchess Azaro was not His Majesty's first choice for security councilor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're saying she snuck into my fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're saying she snuck into my father's room to amend the order?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He wanted you for the job after al..."
entries.dialogueText: "He wanted you for the job after all?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And who was?""
entries.dialogueText: "And who was?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Why... yes. It would appear so.""
entries.dialogueText: "Why... yes. It would appear so."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""That's the most likely explanation.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's the most likely explanation."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Ehm. I was, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ehm. I was, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I never told you because I was emb..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never told you because I was embarrassed to have petitioned. I believed the King rejected me due to my lack of experience."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But it seems that's not what happe..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it seems that's not what happened."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Rightly so, as it turns out.""
entries.dialogueText: "Rightly so, as it turns out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why wouldn't he want Lucita for th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why wouldn't he want Lucita for the position? She was the daughter of one of his most trusted advisors."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""That didn't mean he trusted *her*.""
entries.dialogueText: "That didn't mean he trusted *her*."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My guess is she hoped to persuade..."
entries.dialogueText: "My guess is she hoped to persuade him to change his mind. When he stood firm, she resorted to other means."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Charitably, perhaps she only meant..."
entries.dialogueText: "Charitably, perhaps she only meant to incapacitate him. Unless, of course, her father informed her about the King's mandragora ritual."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""He may have been suspicious of her..."
entries.dialogueText: "He may have been suspicious of her motivations. A woman that age, still unmarried, jostling for a seat closer to the crown..."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your father could have taken it hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your father could have taken it himself. His medicine stores were cleared out long before this investigation began."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""There's still a small possibility..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's still a small possibility that either Hugo or the Grand Wiseman slipped the poison to him."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Alternately, the Grand Vizier coul..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alternately, the Grand Vizier could have administered it to him. The two of them were alone in your father's room for several minutes."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But the discovery of the vial in L..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the discovery of the vial in Lucita's possession, combined with the motive I've just unearthed, strongly points towards her as our primary suspect."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've heard enough. What does the D..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard enough. What does the Duchess herself have to say about all this?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We'll find out shortly. I sent her..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll find out shortly. I sent her a summons. She should be arriving any minute."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Nothing, sir. Even under heavy int..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing, sir. Even under heavy interrogation, the prisoner refuses to say a word."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew I did the right thing by na..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew I did the right thing by naming you my security councilor. This just confirms it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's the only other person who pos..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's the only other person who possibly could've known about the ritual Sal and my father were performing. He took advantage of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have changed my mind. We will ch..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have changed my mind. We will charge Sal Ignacius with the murder after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come on. We all know he's guilty...."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on. We all know he's guilty. He must finally be made to answer for his crime."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The wolfsbane was a red herring. M..."
entries.dialogueText: "The wolfsbane was a red herring. My father and Lucita were probably both taking it for medicinal reasons."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'll have the Grand Wiseman appreh..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll have the Grand Wiseman apprehended immediately, then."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And I haven't been in the loop on..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I haven't been in the loop on Rizian affairs since the new government was established."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita folded her arms. She avoided..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita folded her arms. She avoided looking at either me or Titus.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That night, your father summoned m..."
entries.dialogueText: "That night, your father summoned me to his quarters in secrecy. I do remember finding it unusual that Captain Gordion was not on duty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He told me that after much deliber..."
entries.dialogueText: "He told me that after much deliberation, he had decided to approve me for a seat on the Royal Council."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He said... he said that God Himsel..."
entries.dialogueText: "He said... he said that God Himself had told him that I was the only one who could take back Pales."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Why would I have murdered His Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why would I have murdered His Majesty after that? If anything, Captain Gordion got wind of the conversation and killed the king himself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did you promise my father you'd re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you promise my father you'd retake Pales?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Where's the guardsman who covered for Titus that night? Can he corroborate any of this?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She nodded defiantly."
entries.dialogueText: She nodded defiantly.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I humored him. I thought I'd be ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "I humored him. I thought I'd be able to stall for time until my father recovered."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I didn't know at the time that Val..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't know at the time that Valero and the General had been planning their own Pales conquest."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But wouldn't you know? God was rig..."
entries.dialogueText: "But wouldn't you know? God was right. I did retake Pales."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The war was your family's plan, no..."
entries.dialogueText: "The war was your family's plan, not God's."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Perhaps it's good that His Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps it's good that His Majesty didn't live long enough to find out God was wrong."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I don't believe for a second that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't believe for a second that war with Pales wasn't your intention all along."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I wouldn't be surprised if, in all..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't be surprised if, in all this excitement, you forgot to mention to the King that you take wolfsbane yourself."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It's unfortunate, Your Majesty. Af..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's unfortunate, Your Majesty. After I dismissed him, he seemingly vanished off the map."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Almost as if someone made him disa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Almost as if someone made him disappear."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Someone such as yourself, Captain?""
entries.dialogueText: "Someone such as yourself, Captain?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Admit it, Captain Gordion. The Gol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Admit it, Captain Gordion. The Golden Guard expansion wasn't enough. Even with the Royal Council dissolved, you see me as an obstacle to power."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Admit it, Captain Gordion. The Gol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Admit it, Captain Gordion. The Golden Guard expansion wasn't enough. You're still hungry for my council seat."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: "This is still all hypothetical, of course. We have no proof of a conspiracy."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The new evidence regarding your fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "The new evidence regarding your father's death can also be manipulated to indicate a certain Toras family member..."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But that would mean letting the re..."
entries.dialogueText: "But that would mean letting the real culprit get away."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The Sazons may also be placated wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Sazons may also be placated with a higher position in government. Keep your enemies close, as they say..."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It's my duty to keep you informed..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's my duty to keep you informed on these matters."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As for your immediate next steps,..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for your immediate next steps, I--"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Now, as for the prisoner Azaro...""
entries.dialogueText: "Now, as for the prisoner Azaro..."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""So, as for the imprisoned Duchess...."
entries.dialogueText: "So, as for the imprisoned Duchess..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And I haven't been in the loop on..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I haven't been in the loop on Rizian affairs since my family so generously offered our lands to the Crown."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She spoke with obvious bitterness."
entries.dialogueText: She spoke with obvious bitterness.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You have stripped my family of pow..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have stripped my family of power. What is the point in subjecting me to further indignities?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Now, please, never summon me here..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, please, never summon me here again. It's too painful."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stood and left without looking..."
entries.dialogueText: She stood and left without looking at me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He no longer resisted as he was dra..."
entries.dialogueText: He no longer resisted as he was dragged out of the throne room.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Now please, never summon me here a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now please, never summon me here again. It's too painful."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We went back through the belonging..."
entries.dialogueText: "We went back through the belongings we confiscated after Duchess Azaro's death and found this in a shadow box containing her medals and insignia. The liquid inside is an exact match to the chemical the tests found."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've heard enough. It's a shame we..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard enough. It's a shame we'll never get Lucita's side of the story."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Even if she were alive, I doubt sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if she were alive, I doubt she'd tell you the truth."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""If she's found guilty posthumously..."
entries.dialogueText: "If she's found guilty posthumously, it will be the ultimate nail in House Azaro's coffin. So to speak."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lucita's honor has been tarnished..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucita's honor has been tarnished enough. I don't see the point in dragging her corpse through the mud."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Perhaps not, but closure on His Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps not, but closure on His Majesty Valero's death is called for."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""So, as for the late Duchess...""
entries.dialogueText: "So, as for the late Duchess..."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Now, as for the late Duchess...""
entries.dialogueText: "Now, as for the late Duchess..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With pleasure. Let her legacy be t..."
entries.dialogueText: "With pleasure. Let her legacy be that of a traitor to the Rizian monarch twice over."
